::: {.caveat .caveat-top role="note"}
**Trends in public hospital planned-care waiting lists, not estimates of how long any one person will wait.** The figures count only patients **accepted** onto a list: a district that declines more referrals can look better without anyone being seen sooner. Not medical advice; talk to your GP or specialist service about your own care. [What these numbers mean](methods.qmd#caveats).
:::
